hints.title: Subarray Decrement Invariant
hints.text: An operation subtracts 1 from contiguous elements without dropping any element below zero.

hints.title: Monotonic Height Maintenance
hints.text: Maintain active height levels with a monotonic collection that pops levels exceeding the current element.

hints.title: New Level Detection
hints.text: Whenever an element exceeds the current top height, a new operation range is initiated.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Each value is pushed and popped at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direct segment decrements simulate time proportional to sum of elements.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Monotonic tracking resolves all operations in a single linear pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Relate problem to skyline building removal and monotonic tracking.
